successors.name: British Colonial Empire
successors.text: Freetown and its colony, a Crown Colony from 1808

ledger.x: 1787: 400 formerly enslaved people from London settle the Province of Freedom at Granville Town.
1788: the colony's land is bought from the Temne.
1792: Freetown is founded on 11 March and becomes the seat.
1792: the Province of Freedom becomes the Freetown or Sierra Leone Colony.
1808: Freetown becomes a British Crown Colony.

wars.name: Burning of Granville Town
wars.outcome: King Jimmy 'burnt the settlement to the ground'; the Province of Freedom lapsed until Granville Town was rebuilt in 1791.

wars.name: French raid on Freetown
wars.outcome: Freetown 'survived being pillaged by the French in 1794' and was rebuilt by the settlers; no territory moved.

certainty.note: The pages give no boundary or area for the colony; the Cliopatria shape (1788-1796) is an unverified envelope.
